title: I Heart NJ
cn: 第 3 集 · 我爱新泽西
novel:
Ted [[discovered|discover]] that Stella lived in New Jersey. He [[dreaded|dread]] the commute and [[resented|resent]] the idea of leaving the city. "I [[belong|belong]] in New York," he [[declared|declare]].

Stella was [[stubborn|stubborn]]. "New Jersey is a great place to [[raise|raise]] a family," she [[insisted|insist]]. The [[tension|tension]] between them grew.

Meanwhile, Robin [[quit|quit]] her job at Metro News 1. She felt [[miserable|miserable]] there and wanted to [[pursue|pursue]] a better [[opportunity|opportunity]]. Barney tried to [[convince|convince]] her to stay in New York. "The city needs you," he said.

Robin was [[torn|torn]]. She loved New York, but her career was [[stalling|stall]]. She considered moving to Japan for a new job. Ted [[opposed|oppose]] the idea. "You can't leave," he said.

"Watch me," Robin replied.

Ted went to New Jersey to visit Stella. He hated the long train ride and the quiet suburbs. But when he saw Stella's house, her garden, and the [[peaceful|peaceful]] street, he paused. "Maybe this isn't so bad," he admitted [[reluctantly|reluctantly]].

Stella smiled. "See? New Jersey has its [[charms|charm]]."

Back in the city, Robin packed her bags. "I have to do this," she told the gang. Barney looked [[devastated|devastate]]. But he said nothing. He just watched her leave.

discover.en: to find something for the first time

dread.en: to feel very anxious about something

resent.en: to feel angry about something unfair

belong.en: to be in the right place

insist.en: to say firmly that something must happen

devastate.en: to make someone feel very upset
